    <style>
        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            user-select: none;
            -webkit-user-select: none;
        }
        body, html {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            background-color: #030611;
            color: #f8fafc;
            font-family: 'Prompt', sans-serif;
        }
        #canvas-container {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 1;
            cursor: grab;
        }
        #canvas-container:active {
            cursor: grabbing;
        }
        /* Glassmorphism HUD Surfaces */
        .hud-glass {
            background: rgba(9, 14, 32, 0.76);
            backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }
        .hud-glass-amber {
            background: rgba(24, 14, 8, 0.82);
            backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.12);
        }
        .hud-glass-danger {
            background: rgba(28, 8, 18, 0.82);
            backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.35);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.15);
        }
        /* Custom Scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 5px;
            height: 5px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
            border-radius: 9999px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.65);
        }
        /* Subtle Glow & Pulse */
        @keyframes pulseGlow {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.65); }
        }
        .active-planet-pill {
            animation: pulseGlow 2.5s infinite ease-in-out;
            border-color: #38bdf8 !important;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25), rgba(14, 116, 144, 0.15)) !important;
        }
        /* Range Slider Styling */
        input[type=range] {
            -webkit-appearance: none;
            background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.9);
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            outline: none;
        }
        input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
            -webkit-appearance: none;
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #38bdf8;
            cursor: pointer;
            border: 2px solid #ffffff;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.8);
            transition: transform 0.15s ease;
        }
        input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover {
            transform: scale(1.2);
        }
        /* 3D Floating Planet Labels */
        .planet-label-3d {
            position: absolute;
            pointer-events: auto;
            cursor: pointer;
            transform: translate(-50%, -140%);
            transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
            z-index: 5;
        }
        .planet-label-3d:hover {
            transform: translate(-50%, -150%) scale(1.08);
            z-index: 15;
        }
        /* Scanline overlay for futuristic feel */
        .scanline-overlay {
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0), rgba(255,255,255,0) 50%, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.02) 50%, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.02));
            background-size: 100% 4px;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ===== Layout fixes (responsive HUD) ===== */
        :root { --hdr-h: 84px; }
        .mode-btn { white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; }
        #left-hud-panel, #right-main-panel { top: calc(var(--hdr-h) + 8px) !important; }
        #left-hud-panel { max-height: calc(100vh - var(--hdr-h) - 110px); overflow: hidden; }
        header nav { scrollbar-width: none; }
        header nav::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
        /* Phone: show all 4 mode tabs at once (label only on the active tab) */
        @media (max-width: 639px) {
            header nav { justify-content: space-between; }
            header nav .mode-btn { flex: 1 1 0; justify-content: center; padding: 0.55rem 0.5rem; }
            header nav .mode-btn:not(.bg-sky-500) span { display: none; }
            header nav .mode-btn.bg-sky-500 { flex: 3 1 0; }
            #left-hud-panel button { white-space: nowrap; font-size: 11px; padding-left: 0.4rem; padding-right: 0.4rem; }
            #left-hud-panel .font-mono { white-space: nowrap; }
        }
        @media (max-width: 767px) {
            header { gap: 6px !important; }
            header nav { order: 3; width: 100%; }
            #left-hud-panel { max-width: 15rem; }
            #left-hud-panel #time-controller-card,
            #left-hud-panel > div:last-child { display: none; }
            #right-main-panel {
                top: auto !important;
                bottom: 5.5rem;
                height: 40vh;
                width: calc(100vw - 1.5rem);
                right: 0.75rem;
            }
        }
    </style>

<body class="relative select-none overflow-hidden">

    <!-- 3D WebGL Canvas -->
    <div id="canvas-container"></div>

    <!-- 3D Floating Labels Layer -->
    <div id="labels-container" class="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-10 overflow-hidden"></div>

    <!-- Flash Overlay for Super Impacts -->
    <div id="impact-flash" class="fixed inset-0 bg-white pointer-events-none opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-700 z-40"></div>

    <!-- TOP NAVIGATION BAR -->
    <header class="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-30 p-3 md:px-6 md:py-3.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pointer-events-none">
        <!-- Brand Logo & Status -->
        <div class="hud-glass rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-3.5 pointer-events-auto">
            <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-400 via-orange-500 to-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/30 relative">
                <i class="fa-solid fa-sun text-white text-lg animate-spin" style="animation-duration: 18s;"></i>
                <span class="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-sky-400 border-2 border-slate-950"></span>
            </div>
            <div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">

                    <h2 class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-white">ระบบสุริยะและดวงอาทิตย์ทำงานอย่างไร?</h2>
                </div>

            <div class="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs md:text-sm text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-amber-500/30">
                    <h3 class="font-bold text-amber-300 text-base mb-1.5">☀️ 1. ดวงอาทิตย์: หัวใจพลังงานนิวเคลียร์ฟิวชัน</h3>
                    <p>ดวงอาทิตย์เป็นดาวฤกษ์ที่มีมวลคิดเป็น <strong>99.86% ของมวลทั้งหมดในระบบสุริยะ</strong> ที่แกนกลางมีอุณหภูมิสูงถึง 15 ล้านองศาเซลเซียส เกิดปฏิกิริยา <em>นิวเคลียร์ฟิวชัน (Nuclear Fusion)</em> หลอมรวมอะตอมไฮโดรเจน 600 ล้านตันต่อวินาทีให้กลายเป็นฮีเลียม และปลดปล่อยพลังงานแสงสว่างความร้อนออกมาเลี้ยงดาวเคราะห์ทุกดวง</p>
                </div>
                <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-sky-500/30">
                    <h3 class="font-bold text-sky-300 text-base mb-1.5">🪐 2. ทำไมดาวเคราะห์จึงโคจรรอบดวงอาทิตย์ไม่หลุดลอยไป?</h3>
                    <p>การทำงานของระบบสุริยะเกิดจากสมดุลระหว่าง <strong>"แรงโน้มถ่วงของดวงอาทิตย์"</strong> ที่ดึงดาวเคราะห์เข้ามาหาศูนย์กลาง กับ <strong>"ความเร็วในการเคลื่อนที่ไปข้างหน้า (แรงเฉื่อย)"</strong> ของดาวเคราะห์ตั้งแต่กำเนิดระบบสุริยะเมื่อ 4,600 ล้านปีก่อน ทำให้ดาวเคราะห์โคจรเป็นวงรีรอบดวงอาทิตย์ตามกฎของเคปเลอร์และนิวตัน</p>
                </div>
                <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-emerald-500/30">
                    <h3 class="font-bold text-emerald-300 text-base mb-1.5">🪨 3. ดาวเคราะห์หินชั้นใน vs ดาวเคราะห์แก๊สชั้นนอก</h3>
                    <p><strong>ดาวเคราะห์ชั้นใน 4 ดวง</strong> (พุธ, ศุกร์, โลก, อังคาร) อยู่ใกล้ดวงอาทิตย์ ความร้อนพัดแก๊สเบาออกไปหมด เหลือแต่หินและโลหะหนาแน่น ส่วน <strong>ดาวเคราะห์ชั้นนอก 4 ดวง</strong> (พฤหัสบดี, เสาร์, ยูเรนัส, เนปจูน) อยู่ไกลและเย็นจัด จึงสะสมแก๊สไฮโดรเจน ฮีเลียม และน้ำแข็งจนมีขนาดใหญ่โตมโหฬาร</p>
                </div>
                <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-rose-500/30">
                    <h3 class="font-bold text-rose-300 text-base mb-1.5">💥 4. การชนกันในอวกาศ: ผู้สร้างและผู้ทำลาย</h3>
                    <p>การชนกันของดาวเคราะห์ไม่ใช่เรื่องไกลตัว! เมื่อ 4,500 ล้านปีก่อน ดาวเคราะห์ขนาดเท่าดาวอังคารชื่อ <strong>"ธีอา (Theia)"</strong> พุ่งชนโลกยุคแรกเศษซากจากการชนรวมตัวกันกลายเป็น <strong>"ดวงจันทร์"</strong> ของเรา และทำให้แกนโลกเอียง 23.5 องศา จนเกิดฤดูกาลที่เอื้อต่อสิ่งมีชีวิต!</p>
                </div>

                    whatIfAir: 'หากอุ่นดาวพลูโตให้เป็น 25 °C และเติมอากาศ ดาวพลูโตทั้งดวงจะกลายเป็น "ดาวมหาสมุทรน้ำลึก" เพราะเปลือกดาวที่เป็นน้ำแข็งจะละลายกลายเป็นน้ำทั้งหมด! และเพราะแรงโน้มถ่วงเพียง 0.06G อากาศจะหลุดลอยสู่อวกาศเร็วมากหากไม่มีโดมกักเก็บ'
                }
            }
        };

        const PLANET_ORDER = ['sun', 'mercury', 'venus', 'earth', 'mars', 'jupiter', 'saturn', 'uranus', 'neptune', 'pluto'];

        /* ============================================================================
         * 2. APPLICATION STATE & GLOBALS
         * ============================================================================ */
        let currentMode = 'explore'; // 'explore' | 'deepdive' | 'humanlab' | 'collision'
        let currentTargetId = 'sun';
        let currentInspectorTab = 'overview';
        let currentLabSubject = 'human_naked';
        let isCrossSectionActive = false;
        let showOrbits = true;
        let showLabels = true;
        let isTimePaused = false;
        let timeMultiplier = 1.0;
        let isRightPanelCollapsed = false;
        let soundEnabled = false;
        let audioCtx = null;

        // Three.js Globals
        let scene, camera, renderer;
        let solarSystemGroup, collisionArenaGroup;
        let planetMeshes = {}; // id -> { group, mesh, clouds, rings, coreGroup, orbitLine, angle, data }
        let sunGlowSprite;
        let starField;

        // Camera Orbit Control State
        let camTargetPos = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0);
        let camCurrentLookAt = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0);
        let spherical = { radius: 95, phi: Math.PI / 3, theta: Math.PI / 4 };
        let targetSpherical = { radius: 95, phi: Math.PI / 3, theta: Math.PI / 4 };
        let isDragging = false;
        let prevMouse = { x: 0, y: 0 };
        let raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
        let mouseVec = new THREE.Vector2();

        // Collision Simulation 3D State
        let collisionState = {
            active: false,
            phase: 'idle', // 'idle' | 'approaching' | 'impact' | 'aftermath'
            bodyA: null,
            bodyB: null,
            shockwaveMesh: null,
            debrisParticles: null,
            debrisVelocities: [],
            velocity: 30,
            angleDeg: 15,
            impactTimer: 0,
            slowMoFactor: 1.0,
            cameraShakeIntensity: 0
        };

        // Gravity Jump Mini-Simulator State
        let jumpAnimState = {
            active: false,
            startTime: 0
        };

        /* ============================================================================
         * 3. PROCEDURAL HIGH-RES PLANET TEXTURE GENERATOR (NO EXTERNAL URLS NEEDED)
         * ============================================================================ */
        function createPlanetTexture(id) {
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = 1024;
            canvas.height = 512;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const w = canvas.width;
            const h = canvas.height;

            if (id === 'sun') {
                // Fiery plasma gradient + solar granules & sunspots
                const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
                grad.addColorStop(0, '#dc2626');
                grad.addColorStop(0.25, '#f97316');
                grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#facc15');
                grad.addColorStop(0.75, '#f97316');
                grad.addColorStop(1, '#dc2626');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

                for (let i = 0; i < 1800; i++) {
                    const x = Math.random() * w;
                    const y = Math.random() * h;
                    const r = Math.random() * 14 + 2;
                    ctx.fillStyle = Math.random() > 0.35 ? 'rgba(254, 240, 138, 0.25)' : 'rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.3)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
                // Sunspots
                for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
                    const x = Math.random() * w;
                    const y = h * 0.25 + Math.random() * (h * 0.5);
                    const r = Math.random() * 10 + 4;
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(69, 10, 10, 0.75)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            } else if (id === 'mercury') {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
                for (let i = 0; i < 900; i++) {
                    const x = Math.random() * w;
                    const y = Math.random() * h;
                    const r = Math.random() * 18 + 2;
                    ctx.fillStyle = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35)' : 'rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.45)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(203, 213, 225, 0.2)';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
            } else if (id === 'venus') {
                const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
                grad.addColorStop(0, '#a16207');
                grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#eab308');
                grad.addColorStop(1, '#a16207');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
                // Swirling sulfuric clouds
                for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 6) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = y % 12 === 0 ? 'rgba(254, 240, 138, 0.22)' : 'rgba(161, 98, 7, 0.25)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    for (let x = 0; x <= w; x += 20) {
                        const offset = Math.sin((x / w) * Math.PI * 4 + y * 0.05) * 14;
                        if (x === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y + offset);
                        else ctx.lineTo(x, y + offset);
                    }
                    ctx.lineTo(w, y + 20);
                    ctx.lineTo(0, y + 20);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            } else if (id === 'earth') {
                // Deep ocean base
                const oceanGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
                oceanGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0c4a6e');
                oceanGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#0284c7');
                oceanGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0c4a6e');
                ctx.fillStyle = oceanGrad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

                // Stylized Continents
                ctx.fillStyle = '#15803d';
                const continents = [
                    { x: 180, y: 150, rx: 90, ry: 75 },
                    { x: 260, y: 320, rx: 55, ry: 95 },
                    { x: 520, y: 160, rx: 75, ry: 65 },
                    { x: 550, y: 290, rx: 65, ry: 85 },
                    { x: 740, y: 170, rx: 130, ry: 85 },
                    { x: 840, y: 360, rx: 55, ry: 40 }
                ];
                continents.forEach(c => {
                    for (let j = 0; j < 28; j++) {
                        const angle = (j / 28) * Math.PI * 2;
                        const px = c.x + Math.cos(angle) * c.rx * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5);
                        const py = c.y + Math.sin(angle) * c.ry * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5);
                        ctx.fillStyle = Math.random() > 0.3 ? '#16a34a' : '#ca8a04';
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(px, py, 28 + Math.random() * 25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fill();
                    }
                });

                // Polar Ice Caps
                ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, 32);
                ctx.fillRect(0, h - 32, w, 32);

                // Wispy White Clouds
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35)';
                for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.ellipse(Math.random() * w, Math.random() * h, Math.random() * 55 + 15, Math.random() * 10 + 3, 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
            } else if (id === 'mars') {
                const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
                grad.addColorStop(0, '#991b1b');
                grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#ea580c');
                grad.addColorStop(1, '#991b1b');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

                for (let i = 0; i < 500; i++) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'rgba(127, 29, 29, 0.35)' : 'rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.28)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(Math.random() * w, Math.random() * h, Math.random() * 26 + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
                // Valles Marineris canyon scar
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(69, 10, 10, 0.75)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 8;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(w * 0.35, h * 0.52);
                ctx.quadraticCurveTo(w * 0.5, h * 0.48, w * 0.65, h * 0.54);
                ctx.stroke();

                // Polar ice caps
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, 20);
                ctx.fillRect(0, h - 20, w, 20);
            } else if (id === 'jupiter') {
                const bandColors = ['#7c2d12', '#d97706', '#fef3c7', '#c2410c', '#fde68a', '#9a3412', '#f59e0b', '#fed7aa', '#7c2d12'];
                const bandH = h / bandColors.length;
                bandColors.forEach((col, idx) => {
                    ctx.fillStyle = col;
                    ctx.fillRect(0, idx * bandH, w, bandH + 4);
                });
                // Turbulence waves
                for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.ellipse(Math.random() * w, Math.random() * h, Math.random() * 60 + 20, Math.random() * 6 + 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }
                // Great Red Spot
                ctx.fillStyle = '#dc2626';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.ellipse(w * 0.62, h * 0.68, 52, 30, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.strokeStyle = '#fca5a5';
                ctx.lineWidth = 4;
                ctx.stroke();
            } else if (id === 'saturn') {
                const bands = ['#a16207', '#eab308', '#fef08a', '#ca8a04', '#fde047', '#ca8a04', '#a16207'];
                const bh = h / bands.length;
                bands.forEach((c, i) => {
                    ctx.fillStyle = c;
                    ctx.fillRect(0, i * bh, w, bh + 2);
                });
                for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(254, 249, 195, 0.15)';
                    ctx.fillRect(0, Math.random() * h, w, 3);
                }
            } else if (id === 'uranus') {
                const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
                grad.addColorStop(0, '#0891b2');
                grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#67e8f9');
                grad.addColorStop(1, '#0e7490');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
            } else if (id === 'neptune') {
                const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
                grad.addColorStop(0, '#1e3a8a');
                grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#2563eb');
                grad.addColorStop(1, '#172554');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
                // High speed methane wind streaks & Great Dark Spot
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(191, 219, 254, 0.35)';
                for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
                    ctx.fillRect(Math.random() * w, Math.random() * h, Math.random() * 90 + 20, 3);
                }
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65)';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.ellipse(w * 0.45, h * 0.58, 42, 24, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            } else if (id === 'pluto') {
                const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
                grad.addColorStop(0, '#475569');
                grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#cbd5e1');
                grad.addColorStop(1, '#334155');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
                // Tombaugh Regio (Heart-shaped nitrogen ice plain)
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.88)';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(w * 0.48, h * 0.48, 55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.arc(w * 0.56, h * 0.48, 55, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }

            const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
            texture.needsUpdate = true;
            return texture;
        }

        function createSunGlowTexture() {
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = 256;
            canvas.height = 256;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(128, 128, 10, 128, 128, 128);
            grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 251, 235, 1)');
            grad.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.85)');
            grad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(234, 88, 12, 0.35)');
            grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(234, 88, 12, 0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256);
            return new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
        }

        /* ============================================================================
         * 4. THREE.JS 3D SOLAR SYSTEM & COLLISION ARENA INITIALIZATION
         * ============================================================================ */
        function initThreeScene() {
            const container = document.getElementById('canvas-container');
            scene = new THREE.Scene();
            scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x030611, 0.0012);

            camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 2000);
            renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' });
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
            renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
            container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

            // Lighting
            const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x334155, 0.85);
            scene.add(ambientLight);

            const sunPointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xfffbeb, 2.2, 600);
            sunPointLight.position.set(0, 0, 0);
            scene.add(sunPointLight);

            // Create Rich 3D Starfield Background
            createStarField();

            // Main Solar System Group
            solarSystemGroup = new THREE.Group();
            scene.add(solarSystemGroup);

            // Collision Arena Group (Hidden until collision mode)
            collisionArenaGroup = new THREE.Group();
            collisionArenaGroup.visible = false;
            scene.add(collisionArenaGroup);

            // Build Sun & All Planets
            buildSolarSystemObjects();

            // Setup Mouse & Touch Camera Controls
            setupCameraInteraction(renderer.domElement);

            // Window Resize Listener
            window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize);
        }

        function createStarField() {
            const starGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
            const starCount = 4500;
            const positions = new Float32Array(starCount * 3);
            const colors = new Float32Array(starCount * 3);

            for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
                const r = 300 + Math.random() * 600;
                const theta = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const phi = Math.acos(2 * Math.random() - 1);
                positions[i * 3] = r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta);
                positions[i * 3 + 1] = r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta);
                positions[i * 3 + 2] = r * Math.cos(phi);

                const tint = Math.random();
                if (tint > 0.8) {
                    colors[i * 3] = 0.7; colors[i * 3 + 1] = 0.85; colors[i * 3 + 2] = 1.0;
                } else if (tint > 0.6) {
                    colors[i * 3] = 1.0; colors[i * 3 + 1] = 0.9; colors[i * 3 + 2] = 0.7;
                } else {
                    colors[i * 3] = 1.0; colors[i * 3 + 1] = 1.0; colors[i * 3 + 2] = 1.0;
                }
            }

            starGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
            starGeo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
            const starMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ size: 1.35, vertexColors: true, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85 });
            starField = new THREE.Points(starGeo, starMat);
            scene.add(starField);
        }

        function buildSolarSystemObjects() {
            const labelsContainer = document.getElementById('labels-container');
            labelsContainer.innerHTML = '';

            PLANET_ORDER.forEach((id, index) => {
                const data = CELESTIAL_DATA[id];
                const planetGroup = new THREE.Group();
                const tex = createPlanetTexture(id);

                // Main Sphere Material
                let mat;
                if (id === 'sun') {
                    mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: tex });
                } else {
                    mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                        map: tex,
                        roughness: 0.75,
                        metalness: 0.08
                    });
                }

                const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(data.radius3D, 48, 48);
                const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
                mesh.rotation.z = data.tilt;
                mesh.userData = { planetId: id };
                planetGroup.add(mesh);

                // Internal Core Cross-Section Group (Shown when user toggles "ผ่าดูแกนดาว")
                const coreGroup = createInternalCoreMesh(data);
                coreGroup.visible = false;
                planetGroup.add(coreGroup);

                // 3D Terraforming Breathable Atmosphere Halo (Toggled in Human Lab)
                const tfAtmoGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(data.radius3D * 1.09, 32, 32);
                const tfAtmoMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
                    color: 0x38bdf8,
                    transparent: true,
                    opacity: 0.28,
                    side: THREE.BackSide,
                    blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending
                });
                const tfAtmoMesh = new THREE.Mesh(tfAtmoGeo, tfAtmoMat);
                tfAtmoMesh.visible = false;
                planetGroup.add(tfAtmoMesh);

                // 3D Artificial Magnetic Shield Rings (Toggled in Human Lab)
                const tfMagGroup = new THREE.Group();
                for (let m = 0; m < 3; m++) {
                    const torusGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(data.radius3D * 1.55, 0.04, 16, 64);
                    const torusMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
                        color: 0xa855f7,
                        transparent: true,
                        opacity: 0.55,
                        blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending
                    });
                    const torus = new THREE.Mesh(torusGeo, torusMat);
                    torus.rotation.y = (m * Math.PI) / 3;
                    tfMagGroup.add(torus);
                }
                tfMagGroup.visible = false;
                planetGroup.add(tfMagGroup);

                // Special Features: Sun Corona Glow
                if (id === 'sun') {
                    const spriteMat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
                        map: createSunGlowTexture(),
                        color: 0xf59e0b,
                        transparent: true,
                        blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending
                    });
                    sunGlowSprite = new THREE.Sprite(spriteMat);
                    sunGlowSprite.scale.set(data.radius3D * 4.2, data.radius3D * 4.2, 1);
                    planetGroup.add(sunGlowSprite);
                }

                // Special Features: Saturn & Uranus Rings
                if (id === 'saturn') {
                    const ringGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(data.radius3D * 1.35, data.radius3D * 2.35, 64);
                    const ringMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                        color: 0xfde68a,
                        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
                        transparent: true,
                        opacity: 0.78,
                        roughness: 0.5
                    });
                    const ringMesh = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
                    ringMesh.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2 - 0.35;
                    planetGroup.add(ringMesh);
                } else if (id === 'uranus') {
                    const ringGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(data.radius3D * 1.4, data.radius3D * 1.65, 64);
                    const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
                        color: 0x67e8f9,
                        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
                        transparent: true,
                        opacity: 0.32
                    });
                    const ringMesh = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
                    ringMesh.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
                    planetGroup.add(ringMesh);
                }

                // Special Features: Earth Moon & Atmosphere Halo
                let moonPivot = null;
                if (id === 'earth') {
                    const haloGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(data.radius3D * 1.06, 32, 32);
                    const haloMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
                        color: 0x38bdf8,
                        transparent: true,
                        opacity: 0.16,
                        side: THREE.BackSide
                    });
                    planetGroup.add(new THREE.Mesh(haloGeo, haloMat));

                    // Earth's Moon
                    moonPivot = new THREE.Group();
                    const moonGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.55, 24, 24);
                    const moonMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xcbd5e1, roughness: 0.9 });
                    const moonMesh = new THREE.Mesh(moonGeo, moonMat);
                    moonMesh.position.set(4.5, 0.4, 0);
                    moonPivot.add(moonMesh);
                    planetGroup.add(moonPivot);
                }

                // Orbit Ring Path
                let orbitLine = null;
                if (data.distance3D > 0) {
                    const orbitPoints = [];
                    const segments = 128;
                    for (let i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
                        const theta = (i / segments) * Math.PI * 2;
                        orbitPoints.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(theta) * data.distance3D, 0, Math.sin(theta) * data.distance3D));
                    }
                    const orbitGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(orbitPoints);
                    const orbitMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
                        color: id === 'earth' ? 0x38bdf8 : 0x334155,
                        transparent: true,
                        opacity: id === 'earth' ? 0.55 : 0.35
                    });
                    orbitLine = new THREE.Line(orbitGeo, orbitMat);
                    solarSystemGroup.add(orbitLine);
                }

                // Initial Orbital Position
                const startAngle = index * 1.1;
                planetGroup.position.set(
                    Math.cos(startAngle) * data.distance3D,
                    0,
                    Math.sin(startAngle) * data.distance3D
                );

                solarSystemGroup.add(planetGroup);

                // Create Floating 3D HTML Label
                const labelEl = document.createElement('div');
                labelEl.className = 'planet-label-3d px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-950/85 border border-slate-700/80 text-[11px] text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg hover:border-sky-400';
                labelEl.innerHTML = `<span>${data.emoji}</span><span class="font-medium">${data.name}</span>`;
                labelEl.onclick = () => selectPlanet(id, true);
                labelsContainer.appendChild(labelEl);

                planetMeshes[id] = {
                    group: planetGroup,
                    mesh: mesh,
                    coreGroup: coreGroup,
                    tfAtmoMesh: tfAtmoMesh,
                    tfMagGroup: tfMagGroup,
                    moonPivot: moonPivot,
                    orbitLine: orbitLine,
                    labelEl: labelEl,
                    angle: startAngle,
                    data: data
                };
            });

            // Also build Asteroid Belt between Mars (43) and Jupiter (58)
            buildAsteroidBelt(49.5, 3.2, 450);
        }

        function createInternalCoreMesh(data) {
            const cg = new THREE.Group();
            const r = data.radius3D;

            // Inner glowing core
            const innerGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 0.42, 32, 32);
            const innerMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: data.layers[0].color });
            cg.add(new THREE.Mesh(innerGeo, innerMat));

            // Middle mantle shell (hemisphere cut)
            const mantleGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 0.75, 32, 32, 0, Math.PI * 1.5);
            const mantleMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                color: data.layers[1].color,
                side: THREE.DoubleSide,
                roughness: 0.4
            });
            cg.add(new THREE.Mesh(mantleGeo, mantleMat));

            // Outer crust shell (hemisphere cut)
            const crustGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(r * 0.98, 32, 32, 0, Math.PI * 1.25);
            const crustMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                color: data.layers[2].color,
                side: THREE.DoubleSide,
                roughness: 0.6,
                transparent: true,
                opacity: 0.85
            });
            cg.add(new THREE.Mesh(crustGeo, crustMat));

            return cg;
        }

        function buildAsteroidBelt(radiusCenter, spread, count) {
            const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
            const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const r = radiusCenter + (Math.random() - 0.5) * spread * 2;
                const y = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.8;
                positions[i * 3] = Math.cos(angle) * r;
                positions[i * 3 + 1] = y;
                positions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(angle) * r;
            }
            geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
            const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: 0x94a3b8, size: 0.45, transparent: true, opacity: 0.6 });
            const belt = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
            solarSystemGroup.add(belt);
        }

        /* ============================================================================
         * 5. CAMERA ORBIT, ZOOM & CLICK RAYCASTING CONTROLS
         * ============================================================================ */
        function setupCameraInteraction(domElement) {
            domElement.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
                isDragging = true;
                prevMouse = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
            });

            window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                if (!isDragging) return;
                const dx = e.clientX - prevMouse.x;
                const dy = e.clientY - prevMouse.y;
                prevMouse = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };

                targetSpherical.theta -= dx * 0.0065;
                targetSpherical.phi = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(Math.PI - 0.15, targetSpherical.phi - dy * 0.0065));
            });

            window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
                isDragging = false;
            });

            // Wheel Zoom
            domElement.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const minR = collisionState.active ? 8 : (CELESTIAL_DATA[currentTargetId].radius3D * 2.1);
                targetSpherical.radius = Math.max(minR, Math.min(240, targetSpherical.radius + e.deltaY * 0.06));
            }, { passive: false });

            // Touch Support for Mobile/Tablet
            let touchStartDist = 0;
            domElement.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                if (e.touches.length === 1) {
                    isDragging = true;
                    prevMouse = { x: e.touches[0].clientX, y: e.touches[0].clientY };
                } else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
                    isDragging = false;
                    touchStartDist = Math.hypot(
                        e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX,
                        e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY
                    );
                }
            }, { passive: true });

            domElement.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
                if (e.touches.length === 1 && isDragging) {
                    const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - prevMouse.x;
                    const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - prevMouse.y;
                    prevMouse = { x: e.touches[0].clientX, y: e.touches[0].clientY };
                    targetSpherical.theta -= dx * 0.007;
                    targetSpherical.phi = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(Math.PI - 0.15, targetSpherical.phi - dy * 0.007));
                } else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
                    const dist = Math.hypot(
                        e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX,
                        e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY
                    );
                    const delta = touchStartDist - dist;
                    touchStartDist = dist;
                    const minR = CELESTIAL_DATA[currentTargetId].radius3D * 2.1;
                    targetSpherical.radius = Math.max(minR, Math.min(240, targetSpherical.radius + delta * 0.12));
                }
            }, { passive: true });

            domElement.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
                isDragging = false;
            });

            // Click on 3D Planet Mesh to Select & Zoom
            domElement.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (collisionState.active) return;
                mouseVec.x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
                mouseVec.y = -(e.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
                raycaster.setFromCamera(mouseVec, camera);

                const clickableMeshes = Object.values(planetMeshes).map(p => p.mesh);
                const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(clickableMeshes);
                if (intersects.length > 0) {
                    const hitId = intersects[0].object.userData.planetId;
                    if (hitId) {
                        selectPlanet(hitId, true);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        function onWindowResize() {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        }

        /* ============================================================================
         * 6. UI SYNCHRONIZATION, PLANET SELECTION & MODE SWITCHING
         * ============================================================================ */
        function buildBottomPlanetDock() {
            const dock = document.getElementById('planet-dock-list');
            dock.innerHTML = '';

            PLANET_ORDER.forEach(id => {
                const d = CELESTIAL_DATA[id];
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.id = `dock-btn-${id}`;
                btn.onclick = () => selectPlanet(id, true);
                btn.className = `px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/70 bg-slate-900/75 hover:bg-slate-800 text-xs flex items-center gap-2 transition shrink-0 ${id === currentTargetId ? 'active-planet-pill' : ''}`;
                btn.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="text-base">${d.emoji}</span>
                    <div class="text-left">
                        <div class="font-semibold text-white leading-none">${d.name}</div>
                        <div class="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-mono mt-0.5">${d.gravityG}G</div>
                    </div>
                `;
                dock.appendChild(btn);
            });
        }

        function selectPlanet(id, zoomIn = true) {
            if (!CELESTIAL_DATA[id]) return;
            currentTargetId = id;
            const d = CELESTIAL_DATA[id];
            playUISound(520, 0.08);

            // If we were in collision mode, exit collision arena back to solar system if user clicks a planet
            if (currentMode === 'collision') {
                switchMode('explore');
            }

            // Update Dock Active State
            PLANET_ORDER.forEach(pid => {
                const el = document.getElementById(`dock-btn-${pid}`);
                if (el) {
                    if (pid === id) el.classList.add('active-planet-pill');
                    else el.classList.remove('active-planet-pill');
                }
            });

            // Update Left Target HUD
            document.getElementById('hud-target-type').textContent = d.type;
            document.getElementById('hud-target-badge').textContent = d.emoji;
            document.getElementById('hud-target-badge').style.background = d.badgeColor;
            document.getElementById('hud-target-name').textContent = `${d.name} (${d.nameEn.split(' ')[0]})`;
            document.getElementById('hud-target-en').textContent = d.nameEn;

            // Update Right Inspector Panel
            document.getElementById('inspector-hero-banner').style.background = d.heroGradient;
            document.getElementById('insp-badge').textContent = d.type;
            document.getElementById('insp-title').textContent = `${d.name} (${d.nameEn})`;
            document.getElementById('insp-subtitle').textContent = `แรงโน้มถ่วง ${d.gravityDisplay} • อุณหภูมิ ${d.tempDisplay}`;
            document.getElementById('insp-unique-feature').textContent = `เอกลักษณ์เด่น: ${d.uniqueFeature}`;

            document.getElementById('stat-temp').textContent = d.tempDisplay;
            document.getElementById('stat-gravity').textContent = d.gravityDisplay;
            document.getElementById('stat-diameter').textContent = d.diameterDisplay;
            document.getElementById('stat-moons').textContent = d.moonsDisplay;
            document.getElementById('stat-day').textContent = d.dayDisplay;
            document.getElementById('stat-year').textContent = d.yearDisplay;
            document.getElementById('insp-description').textContent = d.description;

            // Atmosphere Bars
            const atmoContainer = document.getElementById('insp-atmosphere-list');
            atmoContainer.innerHTML = d.atmosphere.map(a => `
                <div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between text-[11px] mb-0.5">
                        <span class="text-slate-200">${a.name}</span>
                        <span class="font-mono text-sky-300">${a.percent}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                        <div class="h-full rounded-full" style="width: ${Math.max(4, a.percent)}%; background-color: ${a.color};"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');

            // Internal Structure Layers
            const layersContainer = document.getElementById('insp-layers-container');
            layersContainer.innerHTML = d.layers.map((layer, idx) => `
                <div class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 flex items-start gap-3">
                    <div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-950 shrink-0 mt-0.5" style="background-color: ${layer.color};">
                        ${idx + 1}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <h5 class="text-xs font-bold text-white">${layer.name}</h5>
                        <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-300 mt-0.5">${layer.desc}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');

            // Mechanics & Facts
            document.getElementById('insp-mechanics-text').textContent = d.mechanics;
            document.getElementById('insp-facts-list').innerHTML = d.facts.map(f => `<li>${f}</li>`).join('');

            // Apply Cross Section visibility to the selected planet
            applyCrossSectionState();

            // Update Human Survival & What-If Lab for this planet
            updateHumanLabSimulation();

            // Smooth Camera Zoom to Selected Planet
            if (zoomIn) {
                targetSpherical.radius = d.radius3D * 3.4;
                targetSpherical.phi = Math.PI / 2.3;
            }
        }

        function zoomCloseToCurrentTarget() {
            const d = CELESTIAL_DATA[currentTargetId];
            targetSpherical.radius = d.radius3D * 2.25;
            targetSpherical.phi = Math.PI / 2.1;
            playUISound(660, 0.1);
        }

        function resetCameraOverview() {
            if (currentMode === 'collision') {
                switchMode('explore');
            }
            currentTargetId = 'sun';
            targetSpherical.radius = 115;
            targetSpherical.phi = Math.PI / 3.1;
            playUISound(420, 0.1);
        }

        function toggleCrossSection() {
            isCrossSectionActive = !isCrossSectionActive;
            applyCrossSectionState();
            playUISound(isCrossSectionActive ? 740 : 480, 0.1);
        }

        function applyCrossSectionState() {
            PLANET_ORDER.forEach(pid => {
                const p = planetMeshes[pid];
                if (!p) return;
                if (pid === currentTargetId && isCrossSectionActive) {
                    p.mesh.material.transparent = true;
                    p.mesh.material.opacity = 0.22;
                    p.coreGroup.visible = true;
                } else {
                    p.mesh.material.transparent = false;
                    p.mesh.material.opacity = 1.0;
                    p.coreGroup.visible = false;
                }
            });

            const btn1 = document.getElementById('btn-cross-section');
            const btn2 = document.getElementById('btn-cross-section-2');
            if (isCrossSectionActive) {
                btn1.classList.add('bg-amber-500', 'text-slate-950');
                if (btn2) btn2.textContent = 'ปิดโหมดผ่าโครงสร้าง';
            } else {
                btn1.classList.remove('bg-amber-500', 'text-slate-950');
                if (btn2) btn2.textContent = 'ผ่าโครงสร้าง 3D';
            }
        }

        function switchInspectorTab(tab) {
            currentInspectorTab = tab;
            ['overview', 'structure', 'howitworks'].forEach(t => {
                const content = document.getElementById(`insp-content-${t}`);
                const btn = document.getElementById(`insp-tab-${t}`);
                if (t === tab) {
                    content.classList.remove('hidden');
                    content.classList.add('flex');
                    btn.className = 'insp-tab-btn py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-sky-500/20 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/30';
                } else {
                    content.classList.add('hidden');
                    content.classList.remove('flex');
                    btn.className = 'insp-tab-btn py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-slate-400 hover:text-white';
                }
            });
        }

        function switchMode(mode) {
            currentMode = mode;
            playUISound(580, 0.09);

            // Update Top Nav Buttons
            ['explore', 'deepdive', 'humanlab', 'collision'].forEach(m => {
                const btn = document.getElementById(`mode-btn-${m}`);
                if (m === mode) {
                    btn.className = 'mode-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold transition-all flex items-center gap-2 bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/25';
                } else {
                    btn.className = 'mode-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs md:text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-all flex items-center gap-2';
                }
            });

            // Ensure right panel is expanded
            if (isRightPanelCollapsed) toggleRightPanel();

            const viewInspector = document.getElementById('panel-view-inspector');
            const viewHumanLab = document.getElementById('panel-view-humanlab');
            const viewCollision = document.getElementById('panel-view-collision');

            viewInspector.classList.add('hidden');
            viewHumanLab.classList.add('hidden');
            viewCollision.classList.add('hidden');

            if (mode === 'explore') {
                solarSystemGroup.visible = true;
                collisionArenaGroup.visible = false;
                collisionState.active = false;
                viewInspector.classList.remove('hidden');
                switchInspectorTab('overview');
            } else if (mode === 'deepdive') {
                solarSystemGroup.visible = true;
                collisionArenaGroup.visible = false;
                collisionState.active = false;
                viewInspector.classList.remove('hidden');
                switchInspectorTab('structure');
                zoomCloseToCurrentTarget();
                if (!isCrossSectionActive) toggleCrossSection();
            } else if (mode === 'humanlab') {
                solarSystemGroup.visible = true;
                collisionArenaGroup.visible = false;
                collisionState.active = false;
                viewHumanLab.classList.remove('hidden');
                viewHumanLab.classList.add('flex');
                zoomCloseToCurrentTarget();
                updateHumanLabSimulation();
            } else if (mode === 'collision') {
                viewCollision.classList.remove('hidden');
                viewCollision.classList.add('flex');
                enterCollisionArena();
            }
        }

        /* ============================================================================
         * 7. HUMAN SURVIVAL & WHAT-IF TERRAFORMING SIMULATOR LOGIC
         * ============================================================================ */
        function selectLabSubject(subjectId) {
            currentLabSubject = subjectId;
            playUISound(620, 0.07);
            ['human_naked', 'human_suit', 'water', 'plant', 'rover', 'sound_ball'].forEach(id => {
                const btn = document.getElementById(`sub-btn-${id}`);
                if (id === subjectId) {
                    btn.className = 'lab-sub-btn p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-sky-500/25 border border-sky-400 text-white text-xs flex flex-col items-center gap-1 transition';
                } else {
                    btn.className = 'lab-sub-btn p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-700/80 text-slate-300 hover:text-white text-xs flex flex-col items-center gap-1 transition';
                }
            });
            updateHumanLabSimulation();
        }

        function resetTerraforming() {
            document.getElementById('tf-toggle-air').checked = false;
            document.getElementById('tf-toggle-temp').checked = false;
            document.getElementById('tf-toggle-mag').checked = false;
            updateHumanLabSimulation();
        }

        function updateHumanLabSimulation() {
            const d = CELESTIAL_DATA[currentTargetId];
            const lab = d.labData;

            const hasAir = document.getElementById('tf-toggle-air').checked;
            const hasTemp = document.getElementById('tf-toggle-temp').checked;
            const hasMag = document.getElementById('tf-toggle-mag').checked;

            document.getElementById('lab-planet-indicator').textContent = `เป้าหมาย: ${d.emoji} ${d.name}`;

            // Calculate Weight & Jump Height for 60kg human
            const weightOnPlanet = (60 * d.gravityG).toFixed(1);
            const jumpCm = (50 / d.gravityG).toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('lab-weight-calc').textContent = `${weightOnPlanet} กก.`;
            document.getElementById('lab-jump-calc').textContent = `${jumpCm} ซม.`;

            let emoji = '💀';
            let headline = lab.nakedStatus;
            let timerText = lab.nakedTime;
            let primaryDesc = lab.nakedDesc;
            let headlineColor = 'text-rose-400';

            if (currentLabSubject === 'human_naked') {
                if (currentTargetId === 'earth') {
                    emoji = '😊';
                    headlineColor = 'text-emerald-400';
                } else if (hasAir && hasTemp && currentTargetId !== 'sun') {
                    if (['mercury', 'venus', 'mars'].includes(currentTargetId)) {
                        emoji = '🤩';
                        headline = `มนุษย์อาศัยอยู่บน${d.name}โดยไม่ใส่ชุดอวกาศได้!`;
                        timerText = hasMag ? 'อยู่ได้ถาวร!' : 'หลายร้อยปี (รอเติมอากาศ)';
                        headlineColor = 'text-emerald-400';
                        primaryDesc = `เมื่อมีอากาศหายใจ 1 บาร์และอุณหภูมิ 25 °C คุณสามารถถอดหมวกอวกาศสูดอากาศบน${d.name}ได้ทันที! น้ำหนักตัวของคุณจะอยู่ที่ ${weightOnPlanet} กก. (${d.gravityG}G) ${hasMag ? 'และมีสนามแม่เหล็กช่วยป้องกันรังสีดวงอาทิตย์อย่างสมบูรณ์' : 'แต่ระวังรังสีคอสมิกในระยะยาวเพราะยังไม่ได้เปิดสนามแม่เหล็กเทียม'}`;
                    } else {
                        emoji = '🪂';
                        headline = `ต้องอาศัยบน "เมืองบอลลูนลอยฟ้า" เท่านั้น!`;
                        timerText = 'รอดชีวิตบนบอลลูน';
                        headlineColor = 'text-amber-300';
                        primaryDesc = `แม้จะมีอากาศและอุณหภูมิ 25 °C แต่เพราะ${d.name}เป็นดาวเคราะห์แก๊ส/น้ำแข็งที่ไม่มีพื้นดินแข็ง คุณต้องสร้างเมืองลอยฟ้าที่ระดับความสูงความดัน 1 บาร์ โดยรับแรงโน้มถ่วง ${d.gravityG}G`;
                    }
                }
            } else if (currentLabSubject === 'human_suit') {
                emoji = currentTargetId === 'sun' ? '🔥' : (['mercury', 'earth', 'mars'].includes(currentTargetId) ? '🧑‍🚀' : '⚠️');
                headline = currentTargetId === 'sun' ? 'ชุดอวกาศหลอมละลายทันที!' : (['mercury', 'earth', 'mars'].includes(currentTargetId) ? 'ปฏิบัติภารกิจสำรวจพื้นผิวได้!' : 'จมลงสู่ชั้นความดันสูงของดาวแก๊ส');
                timerText = ['mercury', 'earth', 'mars'].includes(currentTargetId) ? '8 - 12 ชม. (ตามออกซิเจน)' : '< 5 นาที';
                headlineColor = ['mercury', 'earth', 'mars'].includes(currentTargetId) ? 'text-sky-300' : 'text-amber-400';
                primaryDesc = lab.suitDesc;
            } else if (currentLabSubject === 'water') {
                emoji = '💧';
                headline = hasAir && hasTemp && currentTargetId !== 'sun' ? 'คงสภาพเป็นน้ำเหลวและเกิดเมฆฝน!' : `สถานะของน้ำ 1 ตันบน${d.name}`;
                timerText = hasAir && hasTemp ? 'คงอยู่เป็นมหาสมุทร' : 'เปลี่ยนสถานะทันที';
                headlineColor = 'text-sky-300';
                primaryDesc = (hasAir && hasTemp && currentTargetId !== 'sun')
                    ? `เมื่อปรับความดันอากาศเป็น 1 บาร์และอุณหภูมิ 25 °C น้ำ 1 ตันจะไม่เดือดหรือแข็งตัว แต่จะไหลกลายเป็นลำธารและระเหยสร้างเมฆฝนบน${d.name}!`
                    : lab.waterDesc;
            } else if (currentLabSubject === 'plant') {
                emoji = '🌱';
                headline = (hasAir && hasTemp && currentTargetId !== 'sun') ? 'พืชสังเคราะห์แสงและเติบโตได้!' : `ชะตากรรมของต้นไม้บน${d.name}`;
                timerText = (hasAir && hasTemp && currentTargetId !== 'sun') ? 'เจริญเติบโตต่อเนื่อง' : 'ตายภายในไม่กี่วินาที';
                headlineColor = (hasAir && hasTemp && currentTargetId !== 'sun') ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-amber-300';
                primaryDesc = (hasAir && hasTemp && currentTargetId !== 'sun')
                    ? `ต้นไม้สามารถเจริญเติบโตและผลิตออกซิเจนได้! แรงโน้มถ่วง ${d.gravityG}G จะทำให้ต้นไม้${d.gravityG < 1 ? 'สูงชะลูดกว่าบนโลกเพราะแรงดึงดูดน้อย' : 'มีลำต้นเตี้ยและแข็งแรงขึ้นเพื่อรับน้ำหนัก'}`
                    : lab.plantDesc;
            } else if (currentLabSubject === 'rover') {
                emoji = '🚙';
                headline = `การส่งหุ่นยนต์สำรวจลงบน${d.name}`;
                timerText = ['mercury', 'earth', 'mars'].includes(currentTargetId) ? 'ทำงานได้หลายปี' : 'ถูกทำลายอย่างรวดเร็ว';
                headlineColor = 'text-sky-300';
                primaryDesc = lab.roverDesc;
            } else if (currentLabSubject === 'sound_ball') {
                emoji = '🎸';
                headline = `ฟิสิกส์ของเสียงและการโยนลูกบอลบน${d.name}`;
                timerText = `แรงโน้มถ่วง ${d.gravityG}G`;
                headlineColor = 'text-purple-300';
                primaryDesc = lab.soundDesc;
            }

            document.getElementById('lab-status-emoji').textContent = emoji;
            document.getElementById('lab-status-headline').textContent = headline;
            document.getElementById('lab-status-headline').className = `text-sm md:text-base font-bold ${headlineColor}`;
            document.getElementById('lab-survival-timer').textContent = timerText;
            document.getElementById('lab-primary-effect').textContent = primaryDesc;
            document.getElementById('lab-atmosphere-effect').textContent = `💡 วิเคราะห์สมมติฐานการดัดแปลงดาว: ${lab.whatIfAir}`;

            // Calculate Habitability Score (0 - 100%)
            let habScore = 0;
            if (currentTargetId === 'earth') {
                habScore = 100;
            } else if (currentTargetId === 'sun') {
                habScore = 0;
            } else {
                const isRocky = ['mercury', 'venus', 'mars', 'pluto'].includes(currentTargetId);
                if (isRocky) habScore += 20;
                if (hasAir) habScore += 35;
                if (hasTemp) habScore += 30;
                if (hasMag) habScore += 15;
            }
            document.getElementById('lab-habitability-score').textContent = `${habScore}%`;
            document.getElementById('lab-habitability-bar').style.width = `${Math.max(4, habScore)}%`;

            // Update Jumper Target Label
            const jumperLabel = document.getElementById('jumper-target-label');
            if (jumperLabel) {
                jumperLabel.textContent = `${d.emoji} ${d.name} (${d.gravityG}G)`;
            }

            // Update 3D Terraforming Atmosphere & Magnetosphere Meshes on the Selected Planet
            PLANET_ORDER.forEach(pid => {
                const p = planetMeshes[pid];
                if (!p) return;
                if (pid === currentTargetId && pid !== 'sun') {
                    p.tfAtmoMesh.visible = hasAir || hasTemp;
                    p.tfAtmoMesh.material.color.setHex(hasAir && hasTemp ? 0x10b981 : 0x38bdf8);
                    p.tfMagGroup.visible = hasMag;
                } else {
                    p.tfAtmoMesh.visible = false;
                    p.tfMagGroup.visible = false;
                }
            });
        }

        function triggerGravityJumpTest() {
            playUISound(680, 0.1);
            jumpAnimState.active = true;
            jumpAnimState.startTime = performance.now();
        }

        function toggleCollisionSlowMo() {
            collisionState.slowMoFactor = collisionState.slowMoFactor === 1.0 ? 0.25 : 1.0;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-col-slowmo');
            if (collisionState.slowMoFactor < 1.0) {
                btn.textContent = '0.25x ช้า';
                btn.classList.add('bg-amber-500/20', 'text-amber-300', 'border-amber-400/50');
            } else {
                btn.textContent = '1.0x';
                btn.classList.remove('bg-amber-500/20', 'text-amber-300', 'border-amber-400/50');
            }
            playUISound(540, 0.08);
        }

        /* ============================================================================
         * 8. 3D COSMIC COLLISION ARENA & SCIENTIFIC IMPACT ENGINE
         * ============================================================================ */
        function enterCollisionArena() {
            solarSystemGroup.visible = false;
            collisionArenaGroup.visible = true;
            collisionState.active = true;

            // Hide floating solar system labels in collision mode
            Object.values(planetMeshes).forEach(p => {
                p.labelEl.style.opacity = '0';
                p.labelEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
            });

            // Position camera nicely for the collision stage
            camTargetPos.set(0, 0, 0);
            targetSpherical.radius = 38;
            targetSpherical.phi = Math.PI / 2.4;
            targetSpherical.theta = 0;

            previewCollisionSetup();
        }

        function updateCollisionSliders() {
            const vel = parseInt(document.getElementById('col-vel-slider').value, 10);
            const angle = parseInt(document.getElementById('col-angle-slider').value, 10);
            collisionState.velocity = vel;
            collisionState.angleDeg = angle;

            document.getElementById('col-vel-label').textContent = `${vel} กม./วินาที`;
            let angleDesc = 'ชนประสานงาตรงกลาง';
            if (angle >= 40) angleDesc = 'เฉี่ยวชนทำมุมเอียง (สร้างวงแหวน/ดวงจันทร์)';
            else if (angle >= 15) angleDesc = 'ชนเกือบตรงกลาง';
            document.getElementById('col-angle-label').textContent = `${angle}° (${angleDesc})`;
            calculateCollisionScienceReport();
        }

        function applyCollisionPreset(targetId, impactorId, vel, angle) {
            document.getElementById('col-target-select').value = targetId;
            document.getElementById('col-impactor-select').value = impactorId;
            document.getElementById('col-vel-slider').value = vel;
            document.getElementById('col-angle-slider').value = angle;
            updateCollisionSliders();
            previewCollisionSetup();
            playUISound(640, 0.08);
        }

        function previewCollisionSetup() {
            // Clear previous arena meshes
            while (collisionArenaGroup.children.length > 0) {
                collisionArenaGroup.remove(collisionArenaGroup.children[0]);
            }

            const targetId = document.getElementById('col-target-select').value;
            const impactorId = document.getElementById('col-impactor-select').value;
            updateCollisionSliders();

            const targetData = CELESTIAL_DATA[targetId] || CELESTIAL_DATA.earth;
            const rA = targetId === 'sun' ? 6.5 : Math.max(2.4, targetData.radius3D * 1.15);

            // Create Body A (Target at Origin)
            const texA = createPlanetTexture(targetId);
            const matA = targetId === 'sun'
                ? new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: texA })
                : new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: texA, roughness: 0.65 });
            const meshA = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(rA, 48, 48), matA);
            meshA.position.set(-4, 0, 0);
            collisionArenaGroup.add(meshA);

            // Create Body B (Impactor at Approach Distance)
            let rB = 1.6;
            let texB;
            if (impactorId === 'asteroid') {
                rB = 0.95;
                texB = createPlanetTexture('mercury');
            } else if (impactorId === 'ice_comet') {
                rB = 1.1;
                texB = createPlanetTexture('uranus');
            } else {
                const impData = CELESTIAL_DATA[impactorId] || CELESTIAL_DATA.mars;
                rB = Math.max(1.3, impData.radius3D * 0.95);
                texB = createPlanetTexture(impactorId);
            }

            const matB = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: texB, roughness: 0.7 });
            const meshB = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(rB, 36, 36), matB);
            const yOffset = Math.sin((collisionState.angleDeg * Math.PI) / 180) * (rA + rB) * 0.75;
            meshB.position.set(18, yOffset, 0);
            collisionArenaGroup.add(meshB);

            // Trajectory Guide Line
            const lineGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
                new THREE.Vector3(18, yOffset, 0),
                new THREE.Vector3(-4, yOffset * 0.25, 0)
            ]);
            const lineMat = new THREE.LineDashedMaterial({ color: 0xf43f5e, dashSize: 0.8, gapSize: 0.5 });
            const trajLine = new THREE.Line(lineGeo, lineMat);
            trajLine.computeLineDistances();
            collisionArenaGroup.add(trajLine);

            collisionState.bodyA = meshA;
            collisionState.bodyB = meshB;
            collisionState.rA = rA;
            collisionState.rB = rB;
            collisionState.targetId = targetId;
            collisionState.impactorId = impactorId;
            collisionState.phase = 'idle';
        }

        function resetCollisionArena() {
            previewCollisionSetup();
            playUISound(440, 0.08);
        }

        function triggerCosmicCollision() {
            if (collisionState.phase === 'approaching') return;
            previewCollisionSetup();
            collisionState.phase = 'approaching';
            playUISound(320, 0.25);
        }

        function createImpactExplosionEffects(impactPos, isSunImpact) {
            // 1. Expanding Shockwave Ring
            const ringGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.5, 1.4, 64);
            const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
                color: isSunImpact ? 0xfef08a : 0xf97316,
                side: THREE.DoubleSide,
                transparent: true,
                opacity: 0.95
            });
            const shockwave = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
            shockwave.position.copy(impactPos);
            shockwave.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2.3;
            collisionArenaGroup.add(shockwave);
            collisionState.shockwaveMesh = shockwave;

            // 2. 600 Debris & Magma Particles Ejected into Space
            const count = 650;
            const pGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
            const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
            const colors = new Float32Array(count * 3);
            collisionState.debrisVelocities = [];

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                positions[i * 3] = impactPos.x;
                positions[i * 3 + 1] = impactPos.y;
                positions[i * 3 + 2] = impactPos.z;

                const speed = (0.12 + Math.random() * 0.45) * (collisionState.velocity / 30);
                const theta = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const phi = Math.acos(2 * Math.random() - 1);
                collisionState.debrisVelocities.push(new THREE.Vector3(
                    Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta) * speed,
                    Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta) * speed * 0.7,
                    Math.cos(phi) * speed
                ));

                // Magma orange / yellow / glowing white debris
                const cRand = Math.random();
                if (cRand > 0.6) {
                    colors[i * 3] = 1.0; colors[i * 3 + 1] = 0.9; colors[i * 3 + 2] = 0.4;
                } else if (cRand > 0.25) {
                    colors[i * 3] = 0.98; colors[i * 3 + 1] = 0.35; colors[i * 3 + 2] = 0.1;
                } else {
                    colors[i * 3] = 0.95; colors[i * 3 + 1] = 0.15; colors[i * 3 + 2] = 0.25;
                }
            }

            pGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
            pGeo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
            const pMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
                size: 0.55,
                vertexColors: true,
                transparent: true,
                opacity: 1.0,
                blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending
            });
            const debris = new THREE.Points(pGeo, pMat);
            collisionArenaGroup.add(debris);
            collisionState.debrisParticles = debris;

            // Screen Flash & Explosion Sound
            const flash = document.getElementById('impact-flash');
            flash.style.opacity = '0.75';
            setTimeout(() => { flash.style.opacity = '0'; }, 350);
            playExplosionSound();

            // Trigger 3D Camera Shockwave Shake
            collisionState.cameraShakeIntensity = 1.6;

            // Turn Body A into a glowing fractured magma world (unless it's the Sun or Jupiter)
            if (collisionState.targetId !== 'sun') {
                collisionState.bodyA.material.emissive = new THREE.Color(0xea580c);
                collisionState.bodyA.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.65;
            } else {
                collisionState.bodyA.scale.set(1.15, 1.15, 1.15);
            }
        }

        function calculateCollisionScienceReport() {
            const targetId = document.getElementById('col-target-select').value;
            const impactorId = document.getElementById('col-impactor-select').value;
            const vel = collisionState.velocity;
            const angle = collisionState.angleDeg;

            const targetName = CELESTIAL_DATA[targetId] ? CELESTIAL_DATA[targetId].name : 'โลก';
            const impMap = {
                mars: 'ดาวอังคาร (ขนาดเท่าดาว Theia)',
                asteroid: 'ดาวเคราะห์น้อยยักษ์ 100 กม.',
                mercury: 'ดาวพุธ',
                earth: 'โลก',
                jupiter: 'ดาวพฤหัสบดี',
                ice_comet: 'ดาวหางน้ำแข็งยักษ์'
            };
            const impName = impMap[impactorId] || impactorId;

            // Calculate synthetic impact kinetic energy scale
            const baseExponent = targetId === 'sun' || impactorId === 'jupiter' ? 36 : (impactorId === 'asteroid' || impactorId === 'ice_comet' ? 26 : 32);
            const energyFactor = ((vel / 30) * (vel / 30) * 2.4).toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('col-energy-badge').textContent = `พลังงาน: ${energyFactor} × 10^${baseExponent} จูล`;

            let title = '';
            let desc = '';
            let timeline = [];

            if (targetId === 'sun') {
                title = `☀️ ${impName} พุ่งตกลงสู่ดวงอาทิตย์: ถูกกลืนหายไปในพลาสมา!`;
                desc = `เนื่องจากดวงอาทิตย์มีมวลคิดเป็น 99.86% ของระบบสุริยะ การที่${impName}พุ่งเข้าชนด้วยความเร็ว ${vel} กม./วินาที แรงไทดัลและความร้อนของชั้นโคโรนาจะฉีกและระเหิดดาวให้สลายเป็นพลาสมาตั้งแต่ก่อนแตะพื้นผิว เกิดเปลวสุริยะ (CME) ขนาดยักษ์พวยพุ่งออกมา แต่ดวงอาทิตย์จะยังคงส่องแสงต่อไปตามปกติ`;
                timeline = [
                    '⏱️ วินาทีที่ปะทะ: แรงโน้มถ่วงดวงอาทิตย์ฉีกดาวผู้ชนออกเป็นสายธารพลาสมา (Tidal Disruption)',
                    '⏱️ +1 ชั่วโมง: เกิดพายุสุริยะและแฟลร์ระดับซุปเปอร์พุ่งกระจายออกไปทั่วระบบสุริยะ',
                    '⏱️ อนาคตระยะยาว: มวลดวงอาทิตย์เพิ่มขึ้นเพียงเสี้ยวเปอร์เซ็นต์ ไม่กระทบสมดุลฟิวชันหลัก'
                ];
            } else if (targetId === 'jupiter' || impactorId === 'jupiter') {
                title = `🟠 การปะทะระดับดาวยักษ์แก๊ส: พายุความร้อนระดับหมื่นองศา!`;
                desc = `เมื่อเกิดการชนกับดาวพฤหัสบดีด้วยความเร็ว ${vel} กม./วินาที วัตถุที่พุ่งชนจะแหวกชั้นเมฆแอมโมเนียลงไปและระเบิดในชั้นไฮโดรเจนความดันสูง เกิดลูกไฟขนาดใหญ่กว่าโลกทั้งใบและทิ้งรอยแผลเป็นสีดำในชั้นบรรยากาศนานหลายปี`;
                timeline = [
                    '⏱️ วินาทีที่ปะทะ: เกิดคลื่นกระแทกความเร็วเหนือเสียงในชั้นบรรยากาศไฮโดรเจน อุณหภูมิพุ่งกว่า 15,000 °C',
                    '⏱️ +1 สัปดาห์: กระแสลมกรดพัดเศษคาร์บอนและซิลิเกตกระจายตัวรอบเส้นศูนย์สูตรดาวพฤหัสบดี',
                    '⏱️ อนาคตระยะยาว: ดาวพฤหัสบดีกลืนมวลทั้งหมดเข้าสู่แกนกลางโดยไม่สูญเสียวงโคจร'
                ];
            } else if (impactorId === 'asteroid' || impactorId === 'ice_comet') {
                title = `☄️ มหันตภัยล้างบางชีวมณฑลบน${targetName}!`;
                desc = `การปะทะของ${impName}ที่ความเร็ว ${vel} กม./วินาที รุนแรงกว่าอุกกาบาตยุคไดโนเสาร์ (Chicxulub) กว่า 1,000 เท่า! เปลือกดาวบริเวณจุดชนจะหลอมละลายทันที เกิดคลื่นสึนามิหินหนืดและฝุ่นบดบังแสงอาทิตย์ยาวนานหลายสิบปี`;
                timeline = [
                    '⏱️ วินาทีที่ปะทะ: เกิดหลุมอุกกาบาตกว้างกว่า 1,200 กม. แผ่นดินไหวระดับ 11+ ไปทั่วทั้งดวง',
                    '⏱️ +24 ชั่วโมง: เศษหินร้อนกลับเข้ามาในชั้นบรรยากาศ ทำให้อุณหภูมิพื้นผิวสูงขึ้นเหมือนเตาอบ',
                    `⏱️ อนาคตระยะยาว: ${impactorId === 'ice_comet' ? 'น้ำแข็งมหาศาลระเหยกลายเป็นไอน้ำและควบแน่นเป็นมหาสมุทรใหม่เมื่อดาวเย็นตัวลง' : 'เกิดฤดูหนาวนิวเคลียร์ยาวนาน ก่อนที่ระบบนิเวศยุคใหม่จะฟื้นตัวในอีกหลายล้านปี'}`
                ];
            } else {
                // Planet-on-Planet Giant Impact (e.g., Earth vs Mars / Theia)
                const isOblique = angle >= 30;
                title = `💥 มหาชนดาวเคราะห์ (${targetName} × ${impName}): กำเนิดดาวมหาสมุทรหินหนืดและดวงจันทร์ใหม่!`;
                desc = `การชนกันของดาวเคราะห์หินด้วยความเร็ว ${vel} กม./วินาที ที่มุม ${angle}° จะปลดปล่อยพลังงานมหาศาลจนเปลือกและเนื้อดาวทั้งดวงหลอมละลายกลายเป็น "มหาสมุทรแมกมา (Magma Ocean)" ${isOblique ? 'มุมชนที่เฉียงทำให้เนื้อดาวส่วนหนึ่งเหวี่ยงออกไปโคจรรอบดาวและรวมตัวเป็นดวงจันทร์ดวงใหม่!' : 'การชนประสานงาทำให้แกนเหล็กของดาวทั้งสองหลอมรวมเป็นแกนเดียวขนาดใหญ่ขึ้น!'}`;
                timeline = [
                    '⏱️ +1 ชั่วโมงหลังชน: เปลือกดาวทั้งหมดกลายเป็นทะเลลาวาเดือด อุณหภูมิพื้นผิวพุ่งสูงกว่า 4,000 °C',
                    '⏱️ +1 เดือน: เศษซากหินและโลหะที่กระเด็นขึ้นสู่วงโคจรกระจายตัวเป็น "วงแหวนหินไฟ" ล้อมรอบดาว',
                    '⏱️ +100 ถึง 10,000 ปี: วงแหวนเศษซากค่อยๆ รวมตัวกันด้วยแรงโน้มถ่วง กลายเป็น "ดวงจันทร์ดวงใหม่" และแกนหมุนของดาวเปลี่ยนองศาไปตลอดกาล!'
                ];
            }

            document.getElementById('col-outcome-title').textContent = title;
            document.getElementById('col-outcome-desc').textContent = desc;
            document.getElementById('col-timeline-list').innerHTML = timeline.map(item => `
                <div class="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800/90">${item}</div>
            `).join('');
        }

        /* ============================================================================
         * 9. HUD UTILITY CONTROLS & WEB AUDIO SYNTHESIZER
         * ============================================================================ */
        function updateTimeSpeed(val) {
            timeMultiplier = parseFloat(val);
            isTimePaused = timeMultiplier === 0;
            document.getElementById('time-speed-label').textContent = isTimePaused ? 'หยุดนิ่ง (0.0x)' : `${timeMultiplier.toFixed(1)}x`;
            document.getElementById('pause-icon').className = isTimePaused ? 'fa-solid fa-play text-emerald-400' : 'fa-solid fa-pause';
        }

        function togglePauseTime() {
            isTimePaused = !isTimePaused;
            const slider = document.getElementById('time-speed-slider');
            if (isTimePaused) {
                document.getElementById('time-speed-label').textContent = 'หยุดนิ่ง (Paused)';
                document.getElementById('pause-icon').className = 'fa-solid fa-play text-emerald-400';
            } else {
                if (timeMultiplier === 0) {
                    timeMultiplier = 1.0;
                    slider.value = 1.0;
                }
                document.getElementById('time-speed-label').textContent = `${timeMultiplier.toFixed(1)}x`;
                document.getElementById('pause-icon').className = 'fa-solid fa-pause';
            }
            playUISound(480, 0.06);
        }

        function toggleOrbits() {
            showOrbits = !showOrbits;
            PLANET_ORDER.forEach(id => {
                const p = planetMeshes[id];
                if (p && p.orbitLine) p.orbitLine.visible = showOrbits;
            });
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-orbits');
            btn.className = showOrbits
                ? 'p-2 rounded-xl bg-sky-500/20 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/30 text-xs transition'
                : 'p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-400 border border-slate-700/60 text-xs transition';
            playUISound(520, 0.06);
        }

        function toggleLabels() {
            showLabels = !showLabels;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-labels');
            btn.className = showLabels
                ? 'p-2 rounded-xl bg-sky-500/20 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/30 text-xs transition'
                : 'p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-400 border border-slate-700/60 text-xs transition';
            playUISound(520, 0.06);
        }

        function toggleRightPanel() {
            isRightPanelCollapsed = !isRightPanelCollapsed;
            const body = document.getElementById('right-panel-body');
            const text = document.getElementById('collapse-panel-text');
            const icon = document.getElementById('collapse-panel-icon');

            if (isRightPanelCollapsed) {
                body.classList.add('hidden');
                text.textContent = 'แสดงหน้าต่างข้อมูล';
                icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-chevron-left';
            } else {
                body.classList.remove('hidden');
                text.textContent = 'ซ่อนหน้าต่างข้อมูล';
                icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-chevron-right';
            }
        }

        function openKnowledgeModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('knowledge-modal');
            modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            modal.classList.add('flex');
