            playUISound(600, 0.09);
        }

        function closeKnowledgeModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('knowledge-modal');
            modal.classList.add('hidden');
            modal.classList.remove('flex');
            playUISound(450, 0.07);
        }

        function toggleSound() {
            soundEnabled = !soundEnabled;
            if (soundEnabled && !audioCtx) {
                const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
                if (AudioContextClass) audioCtx = new AudioContextClass();
            }
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-sound');
            const icon = document.getElementById('sound-icon');
            if (soundEnabled) {
                btn.className = 'p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 text-xs transition';
                icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-volume-high';
                playUISound(660, 0.1);
            } else {
                btn.className = 'p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-400 hover:text-white border border-slate-700/60 text-xs transition';
                icon.className = 'fa-solid fa-volume-xmark';
            }
        }

        function playUISound(freq = 520, duration = 0.08) {
            if (!soundEnabled || !audioCtx) return;
            try {
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        function playExplosionSound() {
            if (!soundEnabled || !audioCtx) return;
            try {
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sawtooth';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(140, audioCtx.currentTime);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(28, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.85);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.85);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.85);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        /* ============================================================================
         * 10. MAIN 3D ANIMATION & PHYSICS LOOP
         * ============================================================================ */
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            const effectiveSpeed = isTimePaused ? 0 : timeMultiplier;

            // 1. Update Solar System Planets Orbit & Rotation
            if (!collisionState.active) {
                PLANET_ORDER.forEach(id => {
                    const p = planetMeshes[id];
                    if (!p) return;

                    // Orbit around Sun
                    if (p.data.distance3D > 0 && effectiveSpeed > 0) {
                        p.angle += p.data.orbitSpeed * effectiveSpeed * 0.35;
                        p.group.position.x = Math.cos(p.angle) * p.data.distance3D;
                        p.group.position.z = Math.sin(p.angle) * p.data.distance3D;
                    }

                    // Rotate around own axis
                    p.mesh.rotation.y += p.data.rotationSpeed * (effectiveSpeed * 0.6 + 0.4);
                    p.coreGroup.rotation.y += 0.005;
                    if (p.tfMagGroup && p.tfMagGroup.visible) {
                        p.tfMagGroup.rotation.y += 0.015;
                        p.tfMagGroup.rotation.z = Math.sin(Date.now() * 0.002) * 0.15;
                    }

                    if (p.moonPivot) {
                        p.moonPivot.rotation.y += 0.025 * (effectiveSpeed + 0.2);
                    }
                });

                // Lock Camera Target onto Currently Selected Planet
                const targetObj = planetMeshes[currentTargetId];
                if (targetObj) {
                    camTargetPos.copy(targetObj.group.position);
                }
            } else {
                // 2. Update 3D Cosmic Collision Arena Physics
                if (collisionState.bodyA) collisionState.bodyA.rotation.y += 0.006;
                if (collisionState.bodyB) collisionState.bodyB.rotation.y += 0.012;

                if (collisionState.phase === 'approaching') {
                    const step = (0.22 + (collisionState.velocity / 120) * 0.35) * collisionState.slowMoFactor;
                    collisionState.bodyB.position.x -= step;
                    const dist = collisionState.bodyA.position.distanceTo(collisionState.bodyB.position);

                    if (dist <= (collisionState.rA + collisionState.rB) * 0.82) {
                        collisionState.phase = 'impact';
                        const impactPoint = new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(
                            collisionState.bodyA.position,
                            collisionState.bodyB.position,
                            0.5
                        );
                        collisionState.bodyB.visible = false;
                        createImpactExplosionEffects(impactPoint, collisionState.targetId === 'sun');
                    }
                } else if (collisionState.phase === 'impact') {
                    // Expand Shockwave Ring
                    if (collisionState.shockwaveMesh) {
                        const scaleStep = 1 + 0.07 * collisionState.slowMoFactor;
                        collisionState.shockwaveMesh.scale.multiplyScalar(scaleStep);
                        collisionState.shockwaveMesh.material.opacity *= (1 - 0.05 * collisionState.slowMoFactor);
                    }
                    // Eject & Orbit Debris Particles
                    if (collisionState.debrisParticles) {
                        const posAttr = collisionState.debrisParticles.geometry.attributes.position;
                        for (let i = 0; i < collisionState.debrisVelocities.length; i++) {
                            const v = collisionState.debrisVelocities[i];
                            posAttr.array[i * 3] += v.x * collisionState.slowMoFactor;
                            posAttr.array[i * 3 + 1] += v.y * collisionState.slowMoFactor;
                            posAttr.array[i * 3 + 2] += v.z * collisionState.slowMoFactor;
                            // Slight gravitational pull back toward Body A to form a ring
                            v.multiplyScalar(0.988);
                        }
                        posAttr.needsUpdate = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            // 2.5 Animate Gravity Jump Comparison Box
            if (jumpAnimState.active) {
                const elapsed = (performance.now() - jumpAnimState.startTime) / 1000; // seconds
                const d = CELESTIAL_DATA[currentTargetId];

                // Earth jump duration ~ 0.9s, max visual height 42px
                const earthDuration = 0.85;
                let earthY = 0;
                if (elapsed < earthDuration) {
                    const tNorm = elapsed / earthDuration;
                    earthY = -4 * 42 * tNorm * (1 - tNorm);
                }

                // Target planet jump duration & height scaled by gravityG
                const gClamped = Math.max(0.06, Math.min(28, d.gravityG));
                const targetDuration = Math.min(2.8, Math.max(0.18, 0.85 / Math.sqrt(gClamped)));
                const targetMaxH = Math.min(54, Math.max(2, 42 / gClamped));
                let targetY = 0;
                if (elapsed < targetDuration) {
                    const tNorm2 = elapsed / targetDuration;
                    targetY = -4 * targetMaxH * tNorm2 * (1 - tNorm2);
                }

                const elEarth = document.getElementById('jumper-earth');
                const elTarget = document.getElementById('jumper-target');
                if (elEarth) elEarth.style.transform = `translateY(${earthY.toFixed(1)}px)`;
                if (elTarget) elTarget.style.transform = `translateY(${targetY.toFixed(1)}px)`;

                if (elapsed > Math.max(earthDuration, targetDuration)) {
                    jumpAnimState.active = false;
                }
            }

            // 3. Smooth Camera Interpolation
            spherical.radius += (targetSpherical.radius - spherical.radius) * 0.08;
            spherical.phi += (targetSpherical.phi - spherical.phi) * 0.08;
            spherical.theta += (targetSpherical.theta - spherical.theta) * 0.08;

            camCurrentLookAt.lerp(camTargetPos, 0.1);

            let cx = camCurrentLookAt.x + spherical.radius * Math.sin(spherical.phi) * Math.cos(spherical.theta);
            let cy = camCurrentLookAt.y + spherical.radius * Math.cos(spherical.phi);
            let cz = camCurrentLookAt.z + spherical.radius * Math.sin(spherical.phi) * Math.sin(spherical.theta);

            // Apply Camera Shake on Cosmic Collision Impact
            if (collisionState.cameraShakeIntensity > 0.01) {
                cx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * collisionState.cameraShakeIntensity;
                cy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * collisionState.cameraShakeIntensity;
                cz += (Math.random() - 0.5) * collisionState.cameraShakeIntensity;
                collisionState.cameraShakeIntensity *= 0.92;
            }

            camera.position.set(cx, cy, cz);
            camera.lookAt(camCurrentLookAt);

            // 4. Update Floating 3D HTML Labels
            if (!collisionState.active) {
                PLANET_ORDER.forEach(id => {
                    const p = planetMeshes[id];
                    if (!p) return;
                    if (!showLabels) {
                        p.labelEl.style.opacity = '0';
                        p.labelEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                        return;
                    }

                    const worldPos = p.group.position.clone();
                    worldPos.y += p.data.radius3D + 1.2;
                    worldPos.project(camera);

                    // Check if in front of camera
                    if (worldPos.z < 1) {
                        const x = (worldPos.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * window.innerWidth;
                        const y = (-(worldPos.y * 0.5) + 0.5) * window.innerHeight;
                        p.labelEl.style.left = `${x}px`;
                        p.labelEl.style.top = `${y}px`;
                        p.labelEl.style.opacity = id === currentTargetId ? '1' : '0.82';
                        p.labelEl.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
                    } else {
                        p.labelEl.style.opacity = '0';
                        p.labelEl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                    }
                });
            }

            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        // Start Application on Window Load
        window.onload = function () {
            initThreeScene();
            buildBottomPlanetDock();
            selectPlanet('earth', false); // Start highlighting Earth while showing good overview
            targetSpherical.radius = 75;
            animate();
        };
    
        // ===== Layout fixes: keep HUD panels below the (wrapping) header =====
        function syncHeaderHeight() {
            const h = document.querySelector('header');
            if (!h) return;
            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--hdr-h', Math.ceil(h.getBoundingClientRect().height) + 'px');
        }
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            syncHeaderHeight();
            const h = document.querySelector('header');
            if (window.ResizeObserver && h) new ResizeObserver(syncHeaderHeight).observe(h);
            // Phones: start with the info panel folded so the 3D scene is visible
            if (window.innerWidth < 768 && !isRightPanelCollapsed) toggleRightPanel();
        });
        window.addEventListener('resize', syncHeaderHeight);
</script>
</body>
</html>
